name: B10-0360/2026 (ESN) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate halt to the Rapid Support Forces assault on El-Obeid in Sudan and warns that the atrocities seen in El Fasher could repeat there. It condemns violence against Christian communities and non-Arab ethnic groups, and urges all sides to respect international humanitarian law. It also asks for safe evacuation routes and humanitarian access, with displaced people kept in neighbouring countries rather than coming to Europe. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- The Parliament demands the RSF stop its assault on El-Obeid and all sides protect civilians.
- It calls for regional evacuation routes, humanitarian access, and no pathways to Europe.
- It backs African Union peace efforts and urges an end to outside military support.
